title: Split brother_printer/cups_queue.py under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring python_pkg/brother_printer/cups_queue.py (424 lines) under the repo-wide 250-line cap by moving the queue-status display and the interactive fix prompt into a new _queue_fix.py, chosen so the CUPS-mutating action primitives stay where their tests patch subprocess and time.
acceptance_criteria: cups_queue.py and the new _queue_fix.py are each at most 250 lines.
The brother_printer suite still reports exactly 402 passing tests -- the same count as before the split, proving no test was dropped or silently skipped.
The package keeps 100% branch coverage of the brother_printer source modules.

_cups_enable_printer, _cups_cancel_all_jobs, _cups_cancel_job and _cups_restart_service remain defined in cups_queue.py, so test_cups_queue.py's patches of subprocess, time, shutil and Path on that module still intercept every call that would otherwise reach the live CUPS daemon.
No assertion is changed and no test is deleted, skipped or weakened; the only test edits are the MOD constant and the import module path following the moved code.
No suppression is added and no coverage exclusion is introduced.
out_of_scope: Changing what any test asserts, or what any display string contains.
Splitting the brother_printer test files, which are separate commits.
Moving the _cups_* primitives, which would let an unpatched subprocess.run restart the real CUPS service during the test run.
Adding a re-export shim in cups_queue for display_cups_queue_status; importers point at the new module directly to keep the dependency direction one-way.
verifier: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/brother_printer/tests -q (expects exactly 402 passed), plus pre-commit run --files on the touched files, plus bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all for the cap.
